title: The design system has the pieces the video mocks are made of
goal: The video mocks use components the SwiftUI design system does not have, so each task drew its own. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?
notes: Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Inventory the mock components (transport, clip bar, track header, ruler, playhead, tile popover, dropdown row, keyframe diamond) against Sources/Photonz shared components
Each missing one becomes a shared SwiftUI component with its tokens from inspector.css/overlays.css and an ImageRenderer snapshot next to the mock
